; The semantic control for instruction-order: two stores to the same address.
; Their order decides what the memory holds, so it is not free to move. A
; normaliser that sorted anchors would call these two files the same and could
; no longer tell a wipe-then-write from a write-then-wipe.
define void @f(ptr %p) {
entry:
  store i32 7, ptr %p, align 4
  store i32 0, ptr %p, align 4
  ret void
}
